ValidationRule.description: Requires the user to use the Activation button to activate the product record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", ISPICKVAL( Product_Status__c ,'Active (Product Live)') && ISCHANGED(Product_Status__c)) && Prod_Config_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please use the Activation button to activate the product. Press cancel and then go to the "Activate Product" button in the upper right corner. Follow the screen prompts to confirm the product status date.
